dual_interface_requirement.shared_feature_rule: Maintain both interfaces as supported product APIs: the Photato API for native document automation and Photato-specific capabilities, and the Adobe Photoshop v2-compatible API for clients using the published contract. They share the native Swift engine; do not duplicate editing algorithms. Preserve the existing Photato /v1 routes and clients rather than replace or silently repurpose them. Every new capability must include Photato API coverage, schemas, documentation and tests; when Adobe defines the corresponding operation, include its compatible interface and conformance tests in the same increment. Keep Photato-only operations distinct rather than inventing Adobe routes. Test equivalent underlying operations across both interfaces and the desktop while respecting each contract’s document/job lifecycle. Report each interface’s actual coverage independently; support for one does not imply support for the other.
